title: Flame Resistant Cotton Fabric Containing Casein and Inorganic Materials Using an Environmentally-Friendly Microwave Assisted Technique
material_form: bleached and mercerized cotton twill fabric
material_form_TGA: bleached and mercerized cotton twill fabric
material_form_LOI: bleached and mercerized cotton twill fabric
treatment_method: Presoak 1 h; MARS 6 microwave at 900 W, 10 min ramp and 10 min hold at 90 C; dry 100 C for 5 min; cure 140 C for 3 min
TG_locator: Table 2 and Thermal Properties section, journal p. 2248; residue is char yield at 600 C
LOI_locator: Table 3 and Flame Retardant Properties section, journal p. 2249
conditions_locator: Experimental, journal p. 2247; TG and LOI subsections; Table 2 caption for TG observation count
pairing_evidence: TG Table 2 and LOI Table 3 use the same four unique CUD labels for initial microwave-treated twill fabrics. The manuscript has one treatment series and postpones laundering experiments to future work. Conflicting descriptors are not used to map samples.
source_location: Experimental p. 2247; Tables 1-3 and accompanying prose pp. 2248-2249; conclusion p. 2252
limitations: CUD-9 urea mass conflicts (13.4 g in Experimental versus 13.3 g in Table 1), so quantitative bath formulation is omitted. CUD-11 add-on 11.6% conflicts with flame-test prose 11.7%, and second onset 268.7 C exceeds the repeated prose range maximum 268.5 C; both fields are withheld. Dual onsets remain source-native, not T5/T10/Tmax. MCC Table 4 is excluded. Control has a possibly reused cross-paper triplet and is not admitted. Complete public author-manuscript text reviewed; no PDF pixel QA claimed.
